# Keybindings

The keys the interface is driven by (`NOCTUA.md §12.8`): the three forms a binding takes, the keys one may name, each channel's default Leader and chord modifier on each keyboard, every binding the catalog declares, and the chords each system keeps for itself.

**These are the defaults, and no person's choice.** A person's own keys are a file in their channel's configuration directory, `<config>/keybindings.json`, judged against the other channels' Leaders; `noctua help keybindings` shows the keys in force and why a choice was refused, with no daemon.

## Forms

| Form | Pressed as |
|---|---|
| `Leader <key>` | a key in the leader menu, after the Leader |
| `Leader+<key>` | a key pressed with the Leader held |
| `Leader+Chord+<key>` | a key pressed with the Leader and the chord modifier held |

A key is a physical key, named as the W3C's `KeyboardEvent.code` names it, so neither Shift nor a keyboard layout turns one key into another; `Chord` names a role, so a binding holds whatever modifier its channel makes the chord modifier. A binding has one spelling, and the build refuses any other.

## Leaders

| Channel | Linux | Windows | macOS |
|---|---|---|---|
| `production` | Alt+Space | Alt+Space | Option+Space |
| `staging` | Ctrl+Alt+Space | Ctrl+Alt+Space | Control+Option+Space |
| `development` | Alt+Super+Space | Alt+Win+Space | Option+Command+Space |

Each Leader held with its channel's chord modifier, which a binding's `Chord` names:

| Channel | Chord modifier | Linux | Windows | macOS |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `production` | `Shift` | Alt+Shift+Space | Alt+Shift+Space | Option+Shift+Space |
| `staging` | `Shift` | Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Space | Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Space | Control+Option+Shift+Space |
| `development` | `Shift` | Alt+Shift+Super+Space | Alt+Shift+Win+Space | Option+Shift+Command+Space |

## Bindings

| Binding | Command | Display name (en) | Display name (pt-BR) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Leader KeyD` | `page.dev` | Open the dev pages | Abrir as páginas de dev |
| `Leader KeyH` | `page.help` | Open help | Abrir a ajuda |
| `Leader KeyQ` | `page.close` | Close a page | Fechar uma página |
| `Leader KeyS` | `page.settings` | Open settings | Abrir as configurações |
| `Leader KeyW` | `page.actions` | Open the window's actions | Abrir as ações da janela |
| `Leader Slash` | `page.shortcuts` | Open the page's shortcuts | Abrir os atalhos da página |
| `Leader Space` | `sidebar.cycle` | Show, focus or hide the sidebar | Mostrar, focar ou esconder a barra |
| `Leader+KeyQ` | `page.close` | Close a page | Fechar uma página |
| `Leader+ArrowUp` | `page.previous` | Show the previous page | Mostrar a página anterior |
| `Leader+ArrowDown` | `page.next` | Show the next page | Mostrar a próxima página |
| `Leader+ArrowLeft` | `page.previous` | Show the previous page | Mostrar a página anterior |
| `Leader+ArrowRight` | `page.next` | Show the next page | Mostrar a próxima página |
